description: Replace the merchant-to-category rules, or call with no rules to list them. Returns the stored rule list. The rules are applied by expense_add whenever a call gives no category of its own.

rules.description: The FULL rule list; it replaces the stored one, so include the rules you want to keep. Omit to list the current rules instead

match.description: Matched against the merchant as a case-insensitive regular expression, and as a plain substring if it is not valid regex. The first matching rule in the list wins

name: category_rules
title: Category rules
